_readme: Pairs whose travel between them is ZERO because the first stop IS the transit to the second.
A cableway, lift or funicular is both a stop and a journey: its dwell already contains the ride,
so routing a road distance between it and the place it delivers you to invents travel that does
not exist. Co-locating the coordinates would fix the time but put the stop in the wrong place on
the map (a downtown cableway station is genuinely downtown), so the leg is zeroed instead.
Direction matters: listed as from → to.

legs.why: The cableway station is in downtown Zhangjiajie and the summit is 7 km away over the cliff, so the router returned a 51-min / 27.2 km road trip around the mountain. You do not drive it — the 75-min cableway dwell already covers the 20-min shuttle, the 7-min express cableway and its 30-45 min peak queue, and it lands you at Tianmen Cave.
The lift is the ascent to the Yuanjiajie plateau; its 60-min dwell is queue plus ride. Already effectively zero (2 min walk) but pinned so a future re-route cannot reintroduce a drive.

The Maglev coordinate is Longyang Road, the CITY end of the line, so the router charged a 37-min road trip from PVG to a train that departs from PVG. The 25-min dwell IS the ride. Travel out of it, to the Puxi hotel, is correctly measured from Longyang Road.
